_comment: OPTIONAL hooks registration to merge into ~/.claude/settings.json (user scope), next to the permissions block from settings.json. Copy the hooks key into your settings.json. Use ABSOLUTE paths: the scripts live in ~/.claude/hooks, not in the project (so ${CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR} does not point at them), and some builds do not expand $HOME/%USERPROFILE% inside hook commands. Replace the ABSOLUTE_HOME placeholder with your real home path (e.g. /home/you or C:/Users/you). guard = recommended security hook; its matcher covers Bash, PowerShell (a separate tool on Windows that Bash rules and a Bash-only matcher miss) and Monitor, plus Write/Edit for the fix-once files and generated agents. format/verify = convenience (allowlist-gated) — delete the blocks you do not want. verify blocks finishing at most CLAUDE_VERIFY_MAX_BLOCKS times in a row (default 3), then shows a still-RED warning. WINDOWS: use the .ps1 scripts. Shell-form commands run through Git Bash, or PowerShell when Git Bash is missing (never cmd), so prefer exec form, which spawns powershell.exe directly with no shell and no nested quoting: { "type": "command", "command": "powershell.exe", "args": ["-NoProfile", "-ExecutionPolicy", "Bypass", "-File", "C:/Users/you/.claude/hooks/guard.ps1"] } — same pattern for format.ps1 and verify.ps1. The shell-form equivalent is: powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File "C:\Users\you\.claude\hooks\guard.ps1". The _optional_perPromptDelegationReminder key below is documentation only; copy its UserPromptSubmit array into hooks if you want it.

_optional_perPromptDelegationReminder._comment: OPT-IN, documentation only. The base plugin's per-prompt auto-delegation reminder from before base 1.6.0, verbatim. Base 1.6.0 replaced it with one SessionStart line (startup, clear, compact). To get the per-prompt reminder back as well, add this UserPromptSubmit array to the hooks object of ~/.claude/settings.json. It fires on every prompt and adds its text to context each time, so it costs tokens on every turn. Shell form: the single-quoted echo needs sh or Git Bash.

hooks.command: echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"UserPromptSubmit","additionalContext":"Standing directive: for substantive tasks, proactively delegate to subagents (Agent tool) or a Workflow and auto-invoke any relevant skill; do not wait to be asked. Scale to task size: answer trivial or conversational prompts inline with no delegation. Prefer parallel subagents for multi-part or multi-file work; verify findings before finalizing."}}'
